bio: I’m originally from Maryland and moved to Boston in 2018. I received my BA in Psychology from Boston College and an Ed.M in Higher Education from HGSE. Prior to joining Kirkland, I worked in various fields, including non-profit, education research, and most recently in program delivery at Harvard Business School. Outside of work, I enjoy reading, listening to podcasts, spending time with friends, and exploring local cafes in search of the best matcha in Boston.
